message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
cfg='''--input /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/min.265
--save_output 0
--save_chksum 0
--num_frames -1
--output /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/out.yuv
--chroma_format YUV_420P
--share_display_buf 0
--max_wd 1920
--max_ht 1080
--max_level 41
--num_cores 2
--loopback 0
--display 0
--arch ARM_A9Q
--soc GENERIC
'''
Path('test.cfg').write_text(cfg)
Path('min.265').write_bytes(b'\x00')
PY
./hevcdec test.cfg > final.log 2>&1; ec=$?; tail -30 final.log; echo EXIT:$ec
